claims.claim_text: Cognition 把 SWE-2 從 Kimi K3 這顆 2.8 兆參數的底模 post-train 出來，官方說法是第一次把 RL 做在多兆參數的規模上
claims.evidence: SWE-2 is post-trained from Kimi K3, a 2.8T-parameter model that had already undergone extensive RL for agentic coding. / With SWE-2, we scaled RL to the multi-trillion-parameter regime for the first time, building on the SWE-1.7 training infrastructure and recipe.
claims.note: 「官方說法是」correctly attributes the first-at-scale claim to Cognition rather than asserting it as independent fact.

claims.claim_text: reward 寫成帶成本懲罰的 R = S - λ_e C，懲罰係數對齊 Pareto frontier 在各 effort 等級的局部斜率
claims.evidence: R=S−λeC, where S∈{0,1} denotes whether a rollout was successful, C denotes the cost of a rollout (a mix of inference cost in USD and rollout time), e denotes the effort level, and λe is a parameter tuned to match the slope of the Pareto curve of the base model at effort level e.
claims.note: Formula and the per-effort-level slope-matching of λe both present verbatim.

claims.claim_text: FrontierCode 1.1 Main 拿到 50.0%，跟 Fable 5.1 的 50.9% 差不到一分，成本則宣稱便宜 64%
claims.evidence: achieving 50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, within one point of Fable 5.1 while being 64% cheaper.
claims.note: All three figures match. 「宣稱」preserves that the 64% cost figure is the vendor's own benchmark claim.

claims.claim_text: Terminal-Bench 2.1 是 92.8%，換到 Terminal-Bench 4 只剩 27.3%
claims.evidence: Terminal-Bench 2.1: 92.8% / Terminal-Bench 4: 27.3%
claims.note: Both scores present. The cross-generation comparison is the author's framing but rests on the two published numbers only.

claims.claim_text: Gavin Gray 把 async/await 的設計空間拆成九個維度，分成 start of life、end of life 與 cancellation 三組
claims.evidence: nine such dimensions from modern implementations of straight-line asynchrony — Start of Life (Eagerness, Suspension), End of Life (Extent, Reference Strength, Destruction, Propagation), Cancellation (Awareness, Direction, Persistence)
claims.note: Count, grouping and all nine dimension names match the source's taxonomy.

claims.claim_text: 同一支小程式的三個變形，測到的七個 runtime 裡沒有任何兩個給出相同輸出
claims.evidence: we show that across the seven runtimes, _no two_ produce the same output for three variations of this simple program!
claims.note: The absolute claim (no two of seven) is the source's own assertion, at the same strength.

claims.claim_text: 作者自己把話說得很鬆：每個維度在效能、記憶體、人因與語意上各有取捨，沒有對錯之分
claims.evidence: Each design dimension has trade-offs of performance, memory usage, ergonomics, semantics, etc. There's no right or wrong answers, and each language has its own design rationale.
claims.note: Paraphrase of the source's own hedge, explicitly flagged as the author's hedging. No strength upgrade.

claims.claim_text: Cognition 的 Eric Lu 用 GNFS 分解掉 RSA-260，格點篩選跑在 GPU 上，用的是自己寫的 siever「glas」，文中宣稱成本比先前公開的最佳結果低十倍
claims.evidence: a new implementation of the general number field sieve (GNFS) for GPUs ... enables factoring numbers at 10x lower cost than the previous public state of the art.
claims.note: Attribution, GPU lattice sieving, the siever name glas and the 10x claim are all in the source. 「宣稱」keeps the 10x figure attributed rather than asserted.

claims.claim_text: 整趟從 2026 年 8 月 18 日跑到 9 月 3 日，約 4,900 GPU-day、也就是 13.5 GPU-year，以當時市價估算約 40 萬美元
claims.evidence: 4,900 GPU-days, or 13.5 GPU-years ... approximately $400k at current market prices
claims.note: Dates, both compute figures and the dollar estimate all match. 「估算」preserves the source's at-current-market-prices framing.

claims.claim_text: 量測、叢集操作與最佳化多半是交給 Devin 的 agent session 端到端跑完的
claims.evidence: Devin otherwise autonomously handled measurements, cluster operations, and optimization end-to-end.
claims.note: 「多半」is weaker than the source's autonomously/end-to-end; deflation is never an error.

claims.claim_text: 外推的數字是 RSA-1024 一個約 3,000 萬美元，而 RSA-2048 仍難上約十億倍、看來不受這次結果影響
claims.evidence: I estimate the cost of factoring RSA-1024 at market GPU prices to be roughly $30M. ... RSA-2048 remains roughly a billion times harder than RSA-1024 and does not appear to be meaningfully affected by this work.
claims.note: 「外推的數字」and 「看來」mirror the source's I-estimate / does-not-appear framing. Strength matched.

claims.claim_text: 1.1.1.1 開始驗證 ML-DSA-44 的 DNSSEC 簽章，一個簽章 2,420 位元組、公鑰 1,312 位元組，超出常見的 1,232 位元組 UDP payload 預算
claims.evidence: 1.1.1.1 now validates DNSSEC signatures made with ML-DSA-44, a post-quantum signature algorithm ... Many DNS implementations use a conservative UDP payload limit of 1,232 bytes, chosen to fit within IPv6's minimum MTU (maximum transmission unit) of 1,280 bytes
claims.note: Both byte figures stated in source; the 1,232 budget is framed as a common conservative limit, which is how the lede frames it.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 的處理不是把回應拆成片段——文中直說分片 UDP 不可靠、應該避免——而是讓權威伺服器回截斷標記，把 resolver 推去 TCP 或其他 transport
claims.evidence: Sending such a response as fragmented UDP is unreliable and should be avoided. Instead, the authoritative server should return a truncated response, prompting the resolver to retry using another transport protocol, usually TCP.
claims.note: Verbatim match including the usually-TCP hedge, preserved as 「TCP 或其他 transport」.

claims.claim_text: 約 85% 的 1.1.1.1 查詢從 UDP 進來，把 Big Pineapple 上所有 DNS 產品一起算則約 60%，其餘走 TCP、DoT 與 DoH
claims.evidence: Around 85% of queries to 1.1.1.1 arrive over UDP ... Across all services handled by Big Pineapple, around 60% of queries arrive over UDP. The remaining 40% use transports such as TCP, DNS over TLS (DoT), and DNS over HTTPS (DoH).
claims.note: Both percentages and the transport list match; 「約」matches the source's around.

claims.claim_text: 2026 年 8 月 28 日到 30 日之間，AS62390 透過 transit 商 AS6204 宣告了 162.55.80.0/24，把落在 Hetzner 162.55.0.0/16 裡的 Softaculous 流量拉走
claims.evidence: Between 28 August 2026 at approximately 20:57 UTC and 30 August 2026 at approximately 06:10 UTC ... 162.55.80.0/24 ... 162.55.0.0/16 (Hetzner) ... AS62390 (NexonHost) ... AS6204 (Zet.net) ... our software update endpoint, our client area / billing site
claims.note: Dates, both ASNs, both prefixes and the affected services all match.

claims.claim_text: Let's Encrypt 的自動網域擁有權驗證同樣被路由進那條劫持路徑，攻擊者因此拿到一張合法憑證，連線端看不到任何警告
claims.evidence: The attacker's server was able to obtain a valid TLS certificate from a public certificate authority (Let's Encrypt) ... the certificate authority's automated domain-ownership validation was _also_ routed through the hijack ... did not show a browser or client certificate warning.
claims.note: Adversarially checked the CA naming: the source does name Let's Encrypt explicitly. The causal chain is the source's own.

claims.claim_text: 在被導走的區間內檢查更新的 Virtualizor 安裝會拿到惡意更新包，內含 /etc/systemd/system/java-jre-update.service，官方說受影響的伺服器只有少數幾台
claims.evidence: We have confirmed that a malicious Virtualizor update package was delivered to a small number of installations. ... a systemd unit at `/etc/systemd/system/java-jre-update.service` ... only a handful of servers rather than the general Virtualizor user base
claims.note: The unit path matches character-for-character. 「官方說」correctly marks the scope figure as the vendor's claim — the source itself admits it cannot produce a definitive list.

claims.claim_text: Shopify 宣布行動端走回 Swift 與 Kotlin，理由是 coding model 進步之後，對他們的 app 與團隊來說同一個功能各寫一次已經不再是以前那個成本
claims.evidence: coding models have gotten dramatically better, and for our apps and our team, building the same feature in Swift and Kotlin no longer carries the cost it used to.
claims.note: Close translation including the scoping qualifier for-our-apps-and-our-team, which the lede keeps rather than generalizing.

claims.claim_text: agent 操作模擬器又慢又脆，靠 accessibility tree 與截圖驅動，改一行程式是幾秒鐘、驗證卻要幾分鐘；他們做了 Helix，強制每個檢查點都要通過測試、視覺審查與對抗式 code review
claims.evidence: Agents can make code changes in seconds, but it takes them several minutes to test the output. ... reliance on the accessibility tree, or screenshots to get the state of the app ... you end up with a huge amount of unmaintainable code that can't be shipped ... Helix that takes a more gradual approach ... must prove its behavior with tests, match the running app in a visual review, survive two adversarial code reviewers
claims.note: All three checkpoint gates present. The source specifies two adversarial reviewers where the lede says only adversarial code review — a deflation, not an inflation.

claims.claim_text: Shop app 從概念驗證到完整原生版上架花了 12 週，Shopify app 本身有 300 多個畫面、widget、Apple Watch app、complication 與 Siri Shortcuts，預定 2026 年稍晚出貨
claims.evidence: from a proof of concept to a fully rebuilt native app published in the app stores in just 12 weeks ... our biggest with 300+ screens, home & lockscreen widgets, Apple Watch app, complications, Siri Shortcuts, etc. ... underway and will ship later this year
claims.note: 12 weeks and 300+ screens match; feature list matches item-for-item. Later-this-year resolves to 2026, and the lede marks it as 預定.

claims.claim_text: workerd 的 module registry 把 specifier 當成真正的 URL 解析，含 query string 與 fragment；相對 import 結果跟 new URL(specifier, base) 一致，import attribute 會被驗證，query string 不同會產生不同 module instance，import.meta 也補上了
claims.evidence: Module specifiers are parsed and resolved as real URLs, including query strings and fragments. ... a specifier with a different query string or fragment is treated as a genuinely distinct module instance, even when it points at the same underlying source. ... Import attributes are correctly validated. ... `import.meta.url`, `import.meta.main`, and `import.meta.resolve()` all work.
claims.note: Every one of the four sub-claims is separately attested in the source.

claims.claim_text: 舊實作把 specifier 當成檔案系統路徑，整包 Worker 事先編譯、每個 V8 isolate 各留一份；新設計把 laziness 與快取共享放進來，模組第一次被 import 時才編譯，isolate 副本之間共用編譯後的程式碼
claims.evidence: resolves specifiers as filesystem-style paths, not URLs ... compiles your entire Worker bundle up front, whether or not a given module ever gets imported, and it keeps a separate, private copy of everything per V8 isolate. ... Modules compile lazily when first imported ... treats laziness and cache sharing as things to design in from day one.
claims.note: Adversarial re-check: the source never states in one sentence that compiled code is shared across isolates at runtime; it states cache sharing as a design principle set against the old registry's per-isolate private copy. The lede is the direct complement of that contrast and stays within the source's framing, but it is the weakest-attested span in item #07.

claims.claim_text: Node.js 相容 API 預設開啟、應用程式大小上限提到 64 MiB，並以 new_module_registry 這個 compatibility flag 選用
claims.evidence: these APIs are now enabled by default ... now up to 64 MiB on all plans — we've removed the limit on compressed bundle size ... the `new_module_registry` compatibility flag
claims.note: Figure, default-on statement and exact flag name all match.

claims.claim_text: PlanetScale 的 Neki 進入 platform preview，立場是「stick to Postgres, don't work around it, fake it, or turn away from it」，每個 shard 上跑的是真的 Postgres
claims.evidence: Neki is now available in platform preview. ... Stick to Postgres, don't work around it, fake it, or turn away from it. ... Extensions, SQL support, and performance behave the way Postgres behaves, because it _is_ Postgres.
claims.note: The quoted string matches the source word-for-word; only sentence-initial capitalization differs.

claims.claim_text: 應用程式連的是 Neki router，走標準 Postgres wire protocol，由 router 負責解析查詢、規劃分散式執行、緩衝並合併結果
claims.evidence: parses your query, builds a plan that decides which shards should run it, sends the work out, and combines the results
claims.note: Standard Postgres wire protocol and the four router responsibilities are both in the source.

claims.claim_text: 每個 shard 是一個 primary 加上兩個以上 replica、跨三個可用區，shard group 讓不同的表與工作負載落在不同的 shard 集合上
claims.evidence: Each shard is a full Postgres cluster with one primary and at least two replicas across 3 availability zones. ... Different tables or workloads can live on different sets of shards
claims.note: Adversarial re-check: the article's summary line says only spread-across-availability-zones, which would have made 三個 a fabricated number. A second targeted fetch found the body text does say across 3 availability zones, so the figure is sourced.

claims.claim_text: 連線池以 sidecar 同時掌握 router 側與 Postgres 側，量的是實際容量而不是估算值；預覽階段官方明說不建議放上 production 工作負載
claims.evidence: on both ends of the connection ... it can size pools to what each instance can actually serve instead of estimating from outside the process ... You should not run production workloads on Neki during the platform preview.
claims.note: The production-workload warning is the source's own explicit sentence, reproduced at full strength.

claims.claim_text: Victor Ciura 定義 Microsoft 內部 tier-1 語言：一條從本機開發到 production 的鋪好的路，含安全工具鏈建置、開發者工具、品質流程、平台整合與 SDL 合規
claims.evidence: a paved path from local development to production: secure toolchain builds, productive developer tooling, quality workflows, deep platform integration, and compliance with the SDL requirements
claims.note: Author identity confirmed; all five definition elements match.

claims.claim_text: 超過 100 個 Microsoft 專案 repo 今天已經用它建置，每週還在增加，範圍從韌體與驅動、kernel 與 hypervisor 到微服務與應用程式
claims.evidence: More than 100 Microsoft project repositories build with it today. This rollout continues each week as more repositories adopt it. ... from firmware and drivers, kernel and hypervisors, to microservices and apps
claims.note: 「文中給的數字是」keeps the count attributed to the vendor post rather than asserted as independently established.

claims.claim_text: production-ready 的時間點標在 2026 年初，self-hosted 則從 Rust 1.90 開始
claims.evidence: has been production-ready since early 2026. It has been self-hosted since Rust 1.90
claims.note: Both the date and the version number match exactly.

claims.claim_text: Satoshi Matsuoka 這篇用 CRT 餘數系統在 FP8 tensor core 上模擬 fp64 矩陣乘法，重點在把運算元轉成餘數平面的那段，那是 tensor 運算開始前就先吃掉資源的階段
claims.evidence: FP8 Ozaki II emulates FP64 matrix multiplication by tensor-core products over a CRT residue system; converting the operands into residue planes (the deconstruction term in the Tensor-Memory Equilibrium model of the companion paper "FP8 is All You Need, Part 1") costs integer-pipe and memory resources before tensor instructions issue.
claims.note: Authorship confirmed and the framing is the abstract's own first sentence.

claims.claim_text: 工程手法是 convert-once 的餘數工作區、走整數管線且常數約化剛好兩個 limb 的 GEMM，再把轉換 pipeline 到 MMA 後面藏起來
claims.evidence: convert-once residue workspaces, an exact two-limb constant-reduction GEMM on integer tensor pipes (or pure-SIMT dp4a), and conversion pipelined behind the MMAs
claims.note: All three engineering elements match the abstract, including the exactness of the two-limb reduction.

claims.claim_text: 論文給的是模型推估、不是實測：作者註明每一個數字都還等著被量出來，在這個前提下，NVIDIA Rubin 上 thread-block cluster 之內能貼到約 473 TFLOPS 的算術上限，輸出放大之後則卡在約 235 TFLOPS 的地板
claims.evidence: This paper engineers that path; every result is a model projection pending measurement. First, a deconstruction-aware model: on the NVIDIA Rubin GPU the emulated rate reaches the arithmetic roof $P_{\rm FP8}/(3r+1)$ ($\approx 473$ TFLOPS at $r=12$) only within one thread-block cluster; larger outputs are re-split on the fly and held at a floor of $\approx 235$ TFLOPS
claims.note: Round 1 verdict: both numbers are in the source, but the paper frames the entire result set as 'every result is a model projection pending measurement', and the original lede's 「貼得到」/「掉到」 read as measured behaviour on shipping hardware. Corrected in round 2 by restoring the projection framing at the head of the sentence; no figure was added or changed.

claims.claim_text: 文中提的 Option C 硬體改動是在非同步複製路徑上加一塊固定功能的餘數轉換單元，宣稱能把地板拉回 473
claims.evidence: a stream-side residue-conversion mode on the asynchronous copy path (Option C), a narrow fixed-function block sized as a bill of materials, takes plane formation off the arithmetic pipes and lifts the floor from 235 TFLOPS to the full 473-TFLOPS roof at unchanged cluster reach
claims.note: Doubly marked as reported claim (「文中提的」、「宣稱」), so the projection framing survives. Description of Option C matches the abstract.
